_comment: backend: openai | anthropic | gemini | ollama. Env: OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY. Ollama assumes http://localhost:11434. Per-model timeout_s/max_tokens override the globals below; timeout is infrastructure patience, not a capability limit, so raising it for local models does not affect comparability. max_tokens IS a capability constraint and is held identical across all seven models.
